title: Inna and Huge Candy Matrix
statementMd:
Inna and Dima decided to surprise Sereja. They brought a really huge candy matrix, it's big even for Sereja! Let's number the rows of the giant matrix from $1$ to $*n*$ from top to bottom and the columns — from $1$ to $*m*$, from left to right. We'll represent the cell on the intersection of the $*i*$-th row and $*j*$-th column as $(*i*, *j*)$. Just as is expected, some cells of the giant candy matrix contain candies. Overall the matrix has $*p*$ candies: the $*k*$-th candy is at cell $(*x*_{*k*}, *y*_{*k*})$.

The time moved closer to dinner and Inna was already going to eat $*p*$ of her favourite sweets from the matrix, when suddenly Sereja (for the reason he didn't share with anyone) rotated the matrix $*x*$ times clockwise by 90 degrees. Then he performed the horizontal rotate of the matrix $*y*$ times. And then he rotated the matrix $*z*$ times counterclockwise by 90 degrees. The figure below shows how the rotates of the matrix looks like.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e7568007666c15d51c557727576c388a0017fbed.png)

Inna got really upset, but Duma suddenly understood two things: the candies didn't get damaged and he remembered which cells contained Inna's favourite sweets before Sereja's strange actions. Help guys to find the new coordinates in the candy matrix after the transformation Sereja made!

## Input

The first line of the input contains fix integers $*n*$, $*m*$, $*x*$, $*y*$, $*z*$, $*p*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{9}; 0 ≤ *x*, *y*, *z* ≤ 10^{9}; 1 ≤ *p* ≤ 10^{5})$.

Each of the following $*p*$ lines contains two integers $*x*_{*k*}$, $*y*_{*k*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*k*} ≤ *n*; 1 ≤ *y*_{*k*} ≤ *m*)$ — the initial coordinates of the $*k*$-th candy. Two candies can lie on the same cell.

## Output

For each of the $*p*$ candies, print on a single line its space-separated new coordinates.

## Note

Just for clarity. Horizontal rotating is like a mirroring of the matrix. For matrix:

```
QWER      REWQ
ASDF  ->  FDSA
ZXCV      VCXZ
```
statementZhMd:
Inna 和 Dima 决定给 Sereja 一个惊喜。他们带来了一个非常巨大的糖果矩阵，甚至对 Sereja 来说都大得惊人！我们将这个巨大矩阵的行从上到下编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$，列从左到右编号为 $1$ 到 $*m*$。第 $*i*$ 行与第 $*j*$ 列交叉处的单元格表示为 $(*i*, *j*)$。正如预期，巨大糖果矩阵中的某些单元格里装有糖果。矩阵中总共有 $*p*$ 颗糖果：第 $*k*$ 颗糖果位于单元格 $(*x*_{*k*}, *y*_{*k*})$ 中。

临近晚餐时间，Inna 已经准备从矩阵中取出 $*p*$ 颗她最喜欢的糖果。就在这时，Sereja（原因他没有告诉任何人）将矩阵顺时针旋转了 $*x*$ 次，每次旋转 90 度。然后，他将矩阵水平翻转了 $*y*$ 次。接着，他又将矩阵逆时针旋转了 $*z*$ 次，每次旋转 90 度。下图展示了矩阵旋转的效果。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e7568007666c15d51c557727576c388a0017fbed.png)

Inna 非常沮丧，但 Dima 突然想到了两件事：糖果没有损坏，而且他记得 Sereja 进行这些奇怪操作之前 Inna 最喜欢的糖果所在的单元格。请帮助他们找出经过 Sereja 的变换后，糖果在糖果矩阵中的新坐标！

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含五个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$、$*x*$、$*y*$、$*z*$、$*p*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{9}; 0 ≤ *x*, *y*, *z* ≤ 10^{9}; 1 ≤ *p* ≤ 10^{5})$。

接下来的 $*p*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*k*}$、$*y*_{*k*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*k*} ≤ *n*; 1 ≤ *y*_{*k*} ≤ *m*)$，表示第 $*k*$ 颗糖果的初始坐标。同一个单元格中可以有两颗糖果。

## 输出格式

对于每颗糖果，在单独一行中输出其以空格分隔的新坐标。

## 说明

为便于理解，水平翻转相当于将矩阵镜像翻转。对于矩阵：

```
QWER      REWQ
ASDF  ->  FDSA
ZXCV      VCXZ
```
